about.title: About Allure
about.p1: Allure curates everyday essentials — audio, wearables, desk setups, cameras, travel gear, apparel, watches, fragrance, and the goods that make daily life better. We pick products we'd actually use, not just list whatever's trending.
about.p2: Every paid order comes with priority support: a private chat thread scoped to that order, and a video call link when our team wants to walk you through something in person.
about.li1: Clear specs and honest descriptions — no inflated claims.
about.li2: Fast, trackable fulfillment from order to delivery.
about.li3: Human support, not a ticket queue that goes nowhere.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.fastestWay: The fastest way to reach us about an existing order is the support chat attached to that order — our team sees those first.
contact.beforeOrderPrefix: For anything before you've placed an order — product questions, bulk pricing, partnerships — email us at
contact.beforeOrderSuffix: . We typically reply within one business day.

trackOrder.q: How do I track my order?
trackOrder.a: Open the order from your Orders page — it shows a step-by-step timeline (placed, paid, shipped, delivered) plus a live support chat once it's paid.

cancelRefund.q: Can I cancel or get a refund?
cancelRefund.a: Yes. From the order page, use "Request cancellation" or "Request refund." Our team reviews every request and follows up in the order chat.

supportChat.q: How does the support chat work?
supportChat.a: Every paid order gets its own private chat thread with our team. If a call helps more than text, we'll drop a one-tap video link right into that thread.

paymentMethods.a: Checkout is handled by Polar's secure hosted payment page — cards and the methods Polar supports in your region.

reviewProduct.a: Yes, once your order for it has been paid — the review form appears on the product page for anyone who's purchased it.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: By placing an order on Allure, you agree to the terms below. This is a general summary, not legal advice — replace with your counsel-reviewed terms before taking real orders.
terms.ordersPaymentBody: Prices are shown in EGP and are confirmed by our server at checkout, not set by the browser. Payment is processed by Polar; we never see or store your card details. An order is confirmed once payment succeeds and you'll see it on your Orders page.
terms.cancellationsRefundsBody: You can request a cancellation before an order ships, or a refund after, from the order page. Requests are reviewed by our team — a request doesn't guarantee approval, but every one gets a response.
terms.accountBody: You're responsible for keeping your account credentials secure. Support and admin roles are granted only to our team.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This is a summary of what we collect and why — replace with your counsel-reviewed policy before taking real orders.
privacy.collect1: Account info (name, email) via Clerk, our authentication provider.
privacy.collect2: Order details and the shipping address you enter at checkout.
privacy.collect3: Support chat messages tied to your order, via Stream Chat.
privacy.dontCollectBody: We never see or store your card details — payment is handled entirely by Polar's hosted checkout.
privacy.thirdPartiesBody: We use Clerk (auth), Polar (payments), Stream (chat/video), ImageKit (product images), and Sentry (error monitoring) to run the store. Each only receives the data it needs to do its job.

shipping.title: Shipping policy
shipping.intro: We ship to the address you provide at checkout — double-check it before paying, since it's what our team ships to.
shipping.orderStatusBody: Track every step on the order page: placed, paid, shipped, delivered. You'll see a timestamp for each, plus any note our team adds when marking an order shipped.
shipping.deliveryIssuesBody: If something arrives damaged or doesn't show up, open the order's support chat — that's the fastest way to reach our team, and it keeps the whole conversation attached to the right order.
